subject: Investigating missing transactions during 2027-05-14 window — SLA appeal and evidence request
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@edgecart.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: EdgeCart Support <support@edgecart.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 10:15:00 +0000
Subject: Missing transactions observed 2027-05-14 (03:10-03:45 UTC) — requesting confirmation for SLA credit

Hi Sean,

We saw a pattern of ~420 checkout transactions that returned 504/timeout from our side between 03:10 and 03:45 UTC on 2027-05-14. Customers reported abandoned carts and a handful of failed orders. Our instrumentation shows 5xx responses coming back from Redwood’s generation endpoint around the same times.

Can you confirm whether this qualifies as an availability event under our contract and share the timeframe/logs you’ll use to evaluate credit eligibility? EdgeCart is evaluating impact to revenue and we need an initial response for our finance team.

Example IDs: ORD-88921, ORD-88973, ORD-89002 (timestamps included in the attached sample).

Please let us know what next steps and what data you need from us.

Thanks — Maria
Maria Lopez
Head of Platform Operations, EdgeCart
+1 415-555-0187

Attachments: sample_order_trace_ORD-88921.txt (text), event_screenshot.png (image)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@edgecart.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 10:38:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Missing transactions observed 2027-05-14 (03:10-03:45 UTC) — requesting confirmation for SLA credit

Hi Maria — thanks for the heads up and the example IDs, that’s helpful. We’ve opened an internal hitless investigation and will prioritize this.

Quick answers up front:
- We will confirm the exact service window and evaluate eligibility against the availability SLO in your contract.
- To speed evidence collection, please send the raw request IDs (EdgeCart request IDs or full request timestamps) for a 30-minute window centered on the times you saw failures. The sample IDs you sent are a good start.

What I’m doing now:
- Looping in Tessa (ops) and David (telemetry) to pull serving traces, routing logs, and auth/cache state for the early-morning window.
- If this looks like an availability gap on our side we’ll produce a log bundle and a recommended credit calculation and schedule a postmortem.

We may ask you for a small syslog export (N minutes) if request contexts are missing in our trace. I attached a short doc with instructions on how to pull a minimal support bundle (request_log_instructions.pdf).

I’ll follow up with an initial timeline within 4 business hours.

Best,
Sean
Sr. Account Lead — Reliability Escalations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: request_log_instructions.pdf
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@edgecart.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 12:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Missing transactions observed 2027-05-14 (03:10-03:45 UTC) — requesting confirmation for SLA credit

Thanks, Sean. Quick update from the ops/telemetry side — attaching an initial log bundle we pulled for 03:00–04:00 UTC (edgecart_log_bundle_20270514.jsonl.gz). Early indicators:
- We see a spike of authorization cache misses in the region serving EdgeCart between 03:09:40 and 03:33:10 UTC.
- Several requests experienced cascading retry amplification: a backend auth lookup timed out intermittently (~120ms -> 1.2s on retry), which caused elevated upstream latency and in some cases 504s returned to EdgeCart.
- No full region outage observed; routing stayed healthy. This looks like a degraded availability window with elevated error rate.

Proposed next steps for evidence and credit evaluation:
1) We’ll produce a consolidated timeline with per-request outcomes (success/504/timeout) and correlate to your ORD IDs.
2) If the confirmed error rate during the window exceeds the contractual SLO threshold, we’ll calculate a proportional credit (pro-rata for affected minutes and impacted qps).
3) We’ll schedule a postmortem and share an RCA with remediation steps.

I attached a small kv-dump of auth-cache state at 03:20 UTC to help validation (auth-cache-kv-dump-20270514.txt).

For now, can Maria confirm whether EdgeCart flushed their client-side retry policy around that time (we’ve seen clients with aggressive retries magnify backend load)? If so, please share the retry window; if not, we’ll assume standard exponential backoff.

Attachment: edgecart_log_bundle_20270514.jsonl.gz (log bundle), auth-cache-kv-dump-20270514.txt (text)

—Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Principal Site Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@edgecart.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 15:04:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Missing transactions observed 2027-05-14 (03:10-03:45 UTC) — requesting confirmation for SLA credit

Thanks, Tessa and Sean — received the log bundle and the kv dump. We verified the three example orders in the bundle and confirm our client did not change retry settings during that window; retries were standard.

Requesting the following:
- A short written confirmation of the final assessed availability window you’ll use for the SLA evaluation (UTC start/end).
- The calculation you will apply for any pro-rata credit (minutes impacted x percent of errors x monthly invoice factor).
- A target delivery date for a postmortem covering root cause and remediation actions. Our finance team needs the credit calculation for their month-end accruals.

If you can provide the confirmation and the credit estimate by EOD Wed (2027-05-19) that would be ideal. We’ll keep this thread for the official exchange; we may open a billing ticket afterwards.

Regards,
Maria
Maria Lopez
Head of Platform Operations, EdgeCart
